answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in glacier, expire in umber, and gale lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 170 aliases therefore needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3913 identities would post 3191 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
